nodes.description: Public uint256 global pusher tracker used for greed/queue limiting and event compression.
Public mapping(address => Pusher) storing per-pusher tracker and time state.
Public uint256 rate limiter state variable (declared, not used in the shown code).
Constant HourglassInterface reference to the external Hourglass (H4D) contract.
Public payable-entry function that buys/sells/reinvests/withdraws on H4D and distributes dividends, guarded by isHuman() modifier.
External payable function intended to accept ETH for dividend distribution (empty body).
Public view returning the contract's ETH balance.
Payable fallback function allowing the contract to receive ETH (used so distribute can call H4D.withdraw).
UintCompressor library helper that packs a value into a bit-range of a uint256.
UintCompressor library helper that extracts a packed bit-range from a uint256.
UintCompressor private helper computing 10**position via SafeMath pwr.
SafeMath overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath overflow-checked addition.
Caller-controlled address used as _pusher and compared with tx.origin in isHuman.
Transaction origin used by isHuman modifier (require(tx.origin == msg.sender)).
Block timestamp (now) used for the greedy/time-limit check and stored into pushers_[].time.
External payable call H4Dcontract_.buy.value(_bal)(_pusher) — reentrancy exposure on untrusted external contract.
External call H4Dcontract_.sell(...) executed inside the reinvest/sell loop — reentrancy exposure.
External call H4Dcontract_.reinvest() inside the while loop — reentrancy exposure.
External call H4Dcontract_.withdraw() after the loop — reentrancy exposure.
Input percent parameter of distribute, required to be between 1 and 99.
Local variable holding msg.sender used as the pusher address.
Local variable holding the contract ETH balance at entry.
Local variable holding the computed masternode payout for the event.
Local variable accumulating compressed event data via UintCompressor.insert.
Local variable threshold used to terminate the reinvest/sell loop.
Local variable tracking dividendsOf(this) and re-estimated each loop iteration.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by distribute as _pusher and in the isHuman requirement.
msg.sender is used as the index key into the pushers_ mapping.
isHuman modifier compares tx.origin with msg.sender, mixing two caller identities.
tx.origin gates execution of distribute through the isHuman modifier.
now (block.timestamp) drives the greed/time-limit branch condition in distribute.
now is written into pushers_[_pusher].time, making stored state timestamp dependent.
distribute reads and increments the global pusherTracker_ state variable.
distribute reads and writes pushers_ mapping entries (tracker and time).
distribute interacts with the external H4Dcontract_ interface reference.
distribute performs an external payable buy() call before completing its own state updates.
distribute calls the external sell() inside the reinvest/sell loop, permitting reentrant control transfer.
distribute repeatedly calls external reinvest() within the loop.
distribute calls external withdraw() before the final pusher time update completes.
H4Dcontract_ state reference is the target of the buy external call.
H4Dcontract_ state reference is the target of the sell external call.
H4Dcontract_ state reference is the target of the reinvest external call.
H4Dcontract_ state reference is the target of the withdraw external call.
distribute calls UintCompressor.insert to build the compressed event payload.
distribute uses SafeMath.mul for balance and tracker arithmetic.
distribute uses SafeMath.sub for the greed check and stop threshold.
insert uses SafeMath.mul for range math.
insert uses SafeMath.sub to clear the target bit-range.
insert uses SafeMath.add to combine the masked and included segments.
insert computes segment boundaries with exponent().
extract uses SafeMath.mul for range math.
extract uses SafeMath.sub to isolate the requested segment.
extract computes segment boundaries with exponent().
exponent relies on SafeMath.pwr/mul to compute powers of ten.

normalization_plan.reason: _percent is a parameter scoped to the distribute function and affects its control flow.
_pusher is a local derived from msg.sender inside distribute.
_bal is a local snapshot of the contract balance inside distribute.
_mnPayout is a local payout value computed inside distribute.
_compressedData is a local storage buffer built inside distribute.
_stop is a local loop-termination threshold inside distribute.
_tracker is a local loop tracker updated inside distribute.
